about: The Katana's one-handed guard idle (KE task 10): CombatIdle1H01 at its own speed and one-handed as the pack keys it, the blade re-aimed low at the right side, pointing forward and a little down, as Elden Ring's one-handed idle carries it (the pack holds it 30 degrees up, which put the 1.3 m blade's tip over the head); the off hand stays on the clip. It loops, as the pack clip does. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
